brain-rot-montage.description: Fast-cut real-clip montage. Minimal VO (hook + 2-4 one-liners), new visual every 1-3s, constant punch-in zooms, big bold captions, zero dead air, no title/end cards. 60-100s. Clips carry the video.

demo-craft.description: Result first (payoff within 2s). Visual theme IS the subject. Scale as spectacle. Works silent. One idea per video. CTA in last 5s only.

explainer.description: Stickman/cartoon origin explainer ('why did humans start X?'). Before/after thumbnail with red arrow. 8 min sweet spot for watch-through + mid-rolls. Zero-competition curiosity topics.

silent-demo.description: No voiceover at all. Kinetic typography + visuals carry everything. Best for topics that are visually self-explanatory.
